### US-061: Thumbnails
- Generate a resized thumbnail for an uploaded image using ImageMagick's convert.
- Requested dimensions are bounded to a sane range.
- A failed conversion surfaces the tool's stderr.
description: TypeScript twin of sec-neg-03-subprocess-list-argv, the correct counterpart to sec-02 (shell command injection). spawnSync is called with the executable and an explicit argument array and `shell: false`; the Node.js child_process documentation states that without the shell option the command is spawned directly with the arguments as a list, so path and dimension values are distinct argv entries and are never parsed as shell syntax. Dimensions are integer- and range-checked and a timeout is set. A reviewer that flags any child_process call over user-influenced paths as command injection would false-positive.
why_clean: shell: false + argument array means no shell parsing; there is no string concatenation into a command line. Arguments are data, not shell script.
trap: Uses child_process on user-supplied file paths - the same API family as the real shell-injection fixture - but in the safe mode.
